mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine's sympathomimetic effects (increased heart rate, blood pressure, contractility) directly antagonize diltiazem's negative inotropic and chronotropic actions, reducing efficacy of rate/rhythm control and potentially precipitating tachycardia or arrhythmias.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and cardiac rhythm closely; consider alternative ADHD medication or increased diltiazem dosing; counsel patient on symptom reporting.
